LEO SATELLITES

Project Leo (formerly Kuiper) is Amazon's planned low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite broadband network, aiming to provide fast, affordable internet to unserved and underserved communities globally. It's designed to be a competitor to SpaceX's Starlink. The constellation will consist of over 3,200 satellites in LEO.
